The Little Moments That Make a Big Difference

Behind every confident little learner is a teacher who guides, observes, encourages and believes.

This Teachers’ Day, we celebrate the wonderful educators at Krityam Montessori who turn everyday moments into opportunities for discovery and growth.

In a Montessori environment, a teacher is not just an instructor — she is a guide, observer, facilitator and gentle presence who allows each child to learn at their own pace.

To the hands that guide,
the hearts that nurture,
and the voices that encourage —

Happy Teachers’ Day to the amazing educators who make learning beautiful!

Little Krishnas, Radhas & Lots of Festive Joy!

Our little ones at Krityam Montessori celebrated the magic of Krishna Janmashtami with colourful traditional attire, joyful music, dance and beautiful moments of togetherness.

From adorable little Krishnas to graceful Radhas, the celebration was filled with music, movement, culture and happiness.

At Krityam, festivals become opportunities for children to experience traditions, express themselves and learn through joyful participation.

A little tradition.
A lot of joy.
Beautiful memories to cherish!

Happy Krishna Janmashtami!

A Day Filled with Music, Wonder & Discovery!

Our little explorers from Krityam Montessori had a wonderful field trip to the Indian Music Experience Museum!

From discovering fascinating musical instruments to experiencing the rich sounds, stories and traditions of Indian music, every moment became a hands-on learning experience.

At Krityam, we believe that learning goes beyond the classroom. Field trips give children the opportunity to observe, explore, ask questions and connect their learning with the world around them.

Listen. Explore. Discover. Learn.
A beautiful day where music became an experience!
